description.source: Exact sku.sku_id -> PvRelations::READ_PROFILE.product_id -> description; PostgreSQL canonical storage pv_product_profiles.sku_id/description
description.semantics: Current catalog profile description, not historical evidence. Return the stored nonblank string unchanged; render as text, never HTML.

null_rules.PROFILE_AMBIGUOUS: More than one exact-SKU profile; do not choose one
null_rules.DESCRIPTION_UNAVAILABLE: Unique profile but null, blank or invalid description

description.publication: Internal sku.view scope, same as the existing Mini App product owner. Publishing is not a new SKU visibility or eligibility filter.

compatibility: No header or explicit r1 keeps r1 and description=null/SOURCE_NOT_DEFINED; r1 response is not silently changed. New App accepts legacy/r1/r2 and requests r2 on P06 GETs only. Unknown revisions and inconsistent status/value pairs remain rejected.
query_policy: One grouped profile read join only in the batched card projection after existing counts. Never N+1, fanout, new filters, new route, or pagination/count changes. All reads use existing P06 snapshot.
failure_policy: Database/source query errors propagate; never convert them into absent/empty success.
cache: private,no-store; Vary includes X-P06-Card-Metadata-Revision, Authorization and Origin. Next GET sees committed profile edits; SKU/stock version is not a description cache key.
authorization: Existing actor/session/warehouse/sku.view and ITEM permission rules unchanged; no writes, new grants or publish bypass.
